labeling: A total of 100 µg tryptic peptides from each sample were labeled with TMT10 plex according to the manufacture’s protocol (Controls: TMT126-TMT128C; BMP-2: TMT129N-TMT131).
mass_analyzer: Each MS scan was acquired at high resolution (120,000 full-width half maximum (FWHM)) at m/z 200 in the Orbitrap with a mass range of 400–1600 Da.
ptm: The searches had the following criteria: database, SwissProt mouse protein database (updated 2017-10) for the Mascot search and UniProt mouse (version 17.07.2017; 75193 sequences) for the Sequest HT search; enzyme, trypsin; maximum missed cleavages, 2; fixed modifications, TMT6plex (N-terminal), TMT6plex (K) and Carbamidomethyl (C).
